title: On representation of integers in linear numeration systems
notes: In Ergodic Theory of Z^d Actions, LMS Lecture Note Series 228 (1996), 345-368. If the characteristic polynomial of a constant-coefficient linear numeration system is the minimal polynomial of a Pisot number, normalization (hence addition) is a finite 2-tape automaton. This is a different hypothesis from Baranwal's time-varying Gamma-system. Phase-0 Gamma=([0;2-bar],[0;1-bar],[0;1-bar]) is Pisot, so existence of some adder is KNOWN; the m-dimensional Baranwal carry is not.
